x: How many Grammy Award winners have an IAU-approved surface feature on Venus named after them? Count competitive Grammys, Lifetime Achievement Awards and Trustees Awards, including awards given to a group the person belonged to; Grammy Hall of Fame entries for recordings do not count. Count each person once. Use IAU names in force as of November 2026. List each person.
notes: The IAU Gazetteer identifies both namesakes; Holiday received a Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award and Carter belonged to the Carter Family, which received one. Search budget was exhausted before a comprehensive census could be verified, so these are not necessarily the only qualifying people.
